entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
The Black Falcons may be the face of the display team, but there's a much larger team working behind the scenes to make every display possible.

Meet some of the people supporting the 2026 RNZAF Black Falcons and helping deliver a safe and successful display season.

In this episode, Squadron Leader Jade Telford-Simms shares how the Display Director coordinates planning, airspace approvals, safety requirements, and the countless details behind every display.

The video also highlights the RNZAF Safety and Surface team, along with Beechcraft and Airbus personnel who support the maintenance and engineering work that helps keep the aircraft flying safely and reliably.

🔗 View the full series: https://nzdf.mil.nz/RNZAF-Black-Falcons-Playlist
🔗 Learn more about the T-6C Texan II aircraft: https://nzdf.mil.nz/Texan
